products.name: Gear Zero Desktop
products.description: The playful side of the Gear line, on your Mac: create games and share them with friends. When a game outgrows it, open the project in Cadre.
products.signing: Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple from 0.2.73
notesStrip: \n---\n(由 Mac 自动打包|Built on a Mac from|If macOS blocks)[\s\S]*$
install: Open the DMG and drag Gear Zero Desktop into Applications.
Versions before 0.2.73 are not notarized: if macOS blocks their first launch, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
After that, Gear Zero Desktop keeps itself up to date.

products.name: Gear Cadre
products.tagline: The AI game studio for your desktop
products.description: Describe a game, play it, and refine it by talking. Exports Godot projects.
products.signing: Not code-signed for Apple or Microsoft
install: macOS: open the DMG and drag Gear Cadre into Applications. If the first launch is blocked: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
Windows: run the installer. When SmartScreen appears, click More info → Run anyway.
Linux: make the AppImage executable (chmod +x) and run it.
After that, Gear Cadre keeps itself up to date.
